exponent.description: Data is modelled and plotted as Cp/T^n (n=0 for high-T fitting, 3 for low-T fitting). This is n.

log_x.description: Use a logarithmic x (temperature) axis on the plot

log_y.description: Use a logarithmic y (heat capacity) axis on the plot

model.description: Model heat capacity over a temperature range from fixed Debye, Einstein and linear components, producing a plot and the modelled data.

data.description: Measured data, two columns per line with no header: temperature (K), heat capacity

debye_components.description: Debye components, each a Debye temperature and a prefactor (fractional weight)

einstein_components.description: Einstein components, each an Einstein temperature and a prefactor (fractional weight)

linear_component.description: Linear (electronic, γ) coefficient. 0 or omitted means no linear term.

start_temp.description: Temperature to start modelling from, in Kelvin (not well defined below ~1.6 K)

end_temp.description: Temperature to finish modelling at, in Kelvin

plot.png.description: Plot of the measured data with the modelled total and per-component curves

model.csv.description: Modelled curve: temperature, total, and each Debye/Einstein/linear component

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the inputs (e.g. prefactors rescaled, low-temperature validity)

optimise.description: Optimise the Debye, Einstein and linear components to best fit the measured data, starting from the supplied values as initial guesses, then model as above.

data.description: Measured data, two columns per line with no header: temperature (K), heat capacity

debye_components.description: Initial-guess Debye components, each a Debye temperature and a prefactor

einstein_components.description: Initial-guess Einstein components, each an Einstein temperature and a prefactor

linear_component.description: Initial-guess linear (electronic, γ) coefficient. 0 or omitted means no linear term.

start_temp.description: Temperature to start modelling from, in Kelvin (not well defined below ~1.6 K)

end_temp.description: Temperature to finish modelling at, in Kelvin

plot.png.description: Plot of the measured data with the fitted total and per-component curves

model.csv.description: Fitted curve: temperature, total, and each Debye/Einstein/linear component

fitted_linear.description: Fitted linear (γ) coefficient, or null if no linear term was used

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the inputs (e.g. prefactors rescaled, low-temperature validity)
